page_title: Better Rename 12: The Batch File Renamer for Mac OS X

sources.entry: BetterRename - The most powerful and complete Mac file renaming application on the market. [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/better-rename-11/id1501308038?platform=mac)

summary.name: Better Rename
summary.one_liner: Better Rename is a batch file renaming application for macOS that uses previews, metadata tags, presets and multi-step rules to rename files.
use_cases: batch renaming photos by EXIF date
renaming music files using ID3 tags
linking RAW and JPEG or sidecar files with matching names
bulk renaming files with regular expressions
importing new file names from a spreadsheet or text file
summary.what_it_does: Users add files by dragging them from the Finder and set rename options that are previewed live as they type. Options are grouped into 15 categories covering text, character, position, conversion and truncation changes. The tag-based engine reads EXIF, camera, lens, location, music (MP3, AAC, FLAC, OGG, APE, M4V, iTunes), and Spotlight metadata to build names. Multi-step actions can combine several rules, with per-filter criteria for different file types. Presets can be saved, organized, shared, and applied by dragging files onto the app icon.
notable: Tag-based renaming using photo, music, video and camera metadata
Live preview of changes with change highlighting in version 12
Presets that can be applied by dragging files onto the app icon
caveats: Full licenses (Single User, Family, Business, Enterprise) and upgrades are sold only through the web store; a free trial is offered
Requires macOS 10.15 or later for version 12.36 (older versions support earlier macOS)
